name: git
description: Git helpers: a fast add-all-and-commit flow, a guided merge with conflict repair and worktree cleanup, and idempotent per-spec worktree entry. Changelog (last 3): 1.16.0 — /git:commit Step 3b runs supersession-rows.js --commit HEAD when the spec ledger exists, so a commit that flips a spec to status: superseded appends one spec-superseded escape row; a failure prints one warning line and never blocks the commit. 1.15.0 — /git:commit step 3 reads the script's pick, passes --primary for the diagnosed file, and records the stage:fix row when escape-row refuses a duplicate. 1.14.0 — /git:merge Step 3 honours policy.mergeStrategy.
